name: scaffolde-capability-builder
description: Draft, structurally check, and render reusable capability specifications. The tools do not install or execute the capabilities you draft.

interface.longDescription: Compose a reusable capability specification with stable claims and an evidence plan. Deterministic tools check its structure and render Markdown; they do not install or execute capabilities. Support: pai@scaffolde.ai.
defaultPrompt: Turn my recurring task into a reusable capability draft.
Check my capability draft for missing claims and evidence plans.
Render my capability specification as reviewable Markdown.
